location: Appendix I1A: reliability acceptance and measurement distinction
before: Unless a stricter implementation-defined threshold is declared ex ante in V, the following minimums apply for L2/L3 claims: • inter-rater reliability target = Cohen’s kappa ≥ 0.60 for the primary test battery; • reconstructability audit pass rate ≥ 90% of sampled qualifying episodes within documented tolerances; and • audit sample size n = max(30, 5% of qualifying episodes) per audit period. Implementations MUST record any overridden threshold values in Appendix G field V. Auditors MUST treat missing threshold declarations as audit-incomplete.
after: Unless a stricter implementation-defined threshold is declared ex ante in V, the following minimums apply for L2/L3 claims: • inter-rater reliability target = Cohen’s kappa ≥ 0.60 for the primary test battery; • reconstructability audit pass rate ≥ 90% of sampled qualifying episodes within documented tolerances; and • audit sample size n = max(30, 5% of qualifying episodes) per audit period. Implementations MUST record any overridden threshold values in Appendix G field V. Auditors MUST treat missing threshold declarations as audit-incomplete. For L2/L3 ordered rubric outputs, report the within-one-point agreement rate required by Section 12 and also satisfy this appendix’s Cohen’s kappa minimum of 0.60 (or the stricter preregistered threshold). Preregister the kappa estimator, including any weighting, in V; do not switch estimators after viewing results. Percent agreement alone does not establish this reliability requirement. If kappa is not estimable, record the limitation and leave this requirement unverified rather than substituting percent agreement. The 90% reconstructability pass-rate requirement is separate from inter-rater agreement.

before: L1 uses the general minimum of at least 70%. L2 and L3 use the mandatory threshold of at least 90%; older 85% high-stakes guidance is a planning comparator and does not lower the L2/L3 requirement. Percent agreement within one point is the primary operational metric for ordered rubric outputs; Cohen's kappa is reported where categorical or ordinal labels make it appropriate. The metric and threshold used MUST be declared before review.
after: L1 uses the general minimum of at least 70%. L2 and L3 use the mandatory threshold of at least 90%; older 85% high-stakes guidance is a planning comparator and does not lower the L2/L3 requirement. Percent agreement within one point is the primary descriptive agreement metric for ordered rubric outputs. For L2/L3 reliability acceptance, Appendix I1A additionally requires the preregistered Cohen’s kappa threshold; the descriptive rate does not replace it. The percentages above govern reconstructability pass rates, not a conversion between agreement and kappa. Metrics, estimators and thresholds MUST be declared before review.
